prompt.high_level_description: Repair the top band of an existing pixel art background of a ruined burial courtyard in front of a sunken crypt, keeping its exact palette, light, scale, oblique 2.5D camera and fine controlled dusty hand-painted pixel clusters. Above the crypt's stone lintel there is now only open sky, one plain flat light dusty grey-mauve colour, completely empty, the same as the sky on both sides; only a few short dry roots curl over the lintel's top edge.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Open sky of one flat pale colour above the broken tops of the low ruins.

elements.desc: Plain flat empty pale sky above the crypt's lintel.
